mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_i18n (site_id, locale, name, description, parking_info, access_info) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{locale}, #{name}, #{description}, #{parkingInfo}, #{accessInfo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), parking_info = VALUES(parking_info), access_info = VALUES(access_info)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM site_i18n WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND locale = #{locale}
